mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_balance (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, owner_id, location_id, sku_id, lot_id, quality_code, on_hand_qty, reserved_qty, free_execution_claim_qty, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{ownerId}, #{locationId}, #{skuId}, #{lotId}, #{qualityCode}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
